_comment.about: Since 1.4.0 this half holds rokctapp's landing page sections (Ray, 2026-09-03: each home SDK holds its own landing page, like profile in Dart): base_sdk >= 1.5.0 carries only the generic landing host (app/landing/page.tsx, components/custom/landing-content.tsx, the page-sections.ts registry, the hero) and this SDK registers its floating nav, chat, logos, social, features, workflow, pricing, comparison, faq and testimonials sections into it, one integrations line each at the // @rokct-sdk-page-sections-start marker, in page order (the installer anchors each line after the previous one). Their copy is components/custom/landing/agent-landing-config.ts. base_sdk composes first. Since 1.5.0 it also holds the hero's chat box (Ray, 2026-09-08: "chat box is for chat related stuff, i think if agent sdk is home it inject that chat"): base_sdk 1.7.0's hero carries no input, only a form slot, components/custom/landing/hero-form.ts, a one-marker registry like the others; this SDK installs components/custom/landing/agent-hero-form.tsx - the search-style input, its typewriter placeholders, the submit and the hero-sections.ts results (which that box, not the hero, now loads and renders) - and registers it with one line at // @rokct-sdk-hero-form-start. The form types its props structurally rather than importing hero-form.ts, so against a base_sdk older than 1.7.0 (no hero-form.ts, integration skipped with a warning) the file is installed but unused and the shell still builds with the hero's own box. Since 1.7.0 rokct.ai's own card section is ONE swipeable row below 640px rather than a column of cards (Ray, 2026-09-09: "why rokctai didnt benefit from the change?", after lms_sdk 1.8.0 did the same for supacharge.app). It did not benefit because the sections are NOT shared - base_sdk holds only the landing host, so each home SDK owns its own content sections and lms_sdk could not reach these. components/custom/landing/agent-card-row.ts is that change: one exported class string, AGENT_CARD_ROW, that a card grid adds to the grid it already has, every utility in it behind Tailwind's max-sm: so the whole row compiles into a single @media not all and (min-width: 640px) block and nothing outside it can reach a larger screen. all-features-section.tsx is the only section that takes it, because it was the only stacked card GRID on the page: chat, social and workflow are already carousels, pricing is already a snap scroller, logos and testimonials are marquees, copied-pricing is a fixed-height card fan and the FAQ is an accordion. Its grid drops the grid-cols-1 it no longer needs and pins sm:grid-cols-1 in its place, because its first column break is md: and that grid-cols-1 was also holding the 640-767px band. The row is sized and snapped like the plan scroller pricing.tsx already runs a section away (a card at 85%, centre snap), so the page has one scroller pattern rather than two. No base_sdk change: the floor is unchanged at >= 1.10.0 (LandingNavItem.badge, since 1.6.0) and this SDK ships no CSS file, which is why the row is Tailwind rather than a stylesheet. Since 1.8.0 rokct.ai's header WORDS are here too (Ray, 2026-09-09: rokct.ai and supacharge.app must use ONE header, the same component, with the menu inside it - base_sdk 1.14.0 ships that header, and what it does not know is rokct.ai's menu): components/custom/landing/agent-header-menu.ts default-exports a HeaderMenu built entry for entry from rokctai_frontend's hand-written components/custom/header.tsx and its app/config/features.ts registry - `pricing` as an ANCHOR resolved against copied-pricing.tsx's meta.nav id so it is dropped when the section is not on the page, Affiliate and Teams as fixed links, the Product dropdown's five columns (Product/platforms, AI Chat, Productivity, Tools, Summary) as `groups` with the same new/soon badges, and `Chat with ROK` (ghost) and `Add ROK Extension` (primary, Chrome Web Store, external) as `actions` - registered with one line at // @rokct-sdk-header-menu-start. Labels are read through the shell's `t` (app/lib/i18n, a requires file) with the English beside each key as the fallback. floating-nav.tsx's new/soon pill is base's ONE components/custom/menu-label.tsx, and the hero form's send button paints bg-primary instead of the hard-coded yellow-400, so rokct.ai's brand colour lives in the shell's --primary token like everything else base renders. components/custom/landing/agent-site-metadata.ts registers rokct.ai's <title>, description, tagline, keywords, locale and logo at base_sdk 1.15.0's // @rokct-sdk-site-metadata-start marker (components/custom/landing/site-metadata.ts); that registry is optional in the base floor - against 1.14.0 the installer prints 'Integration target not found' and skips the line, which is why the module declares the shape it fills instead of importing base's SiteMetadataCopy. templates/app/(chat)/opengraph-image.png and twitter-image.png are gone: they were the Vercel 'Gemini Chatbot Starter Template' cards, and with nothing at those App Router conventions base's generated preview image wins. The base_sdk floor is 1.14.0 since 1.8.0. Since 1.9.0 the registered menu fills the two fields base_sdk 1.18.0 added for its mega panel (Ray, 2026-09-09: "no mega menu anymore" on rokct.ai is a regression): the Product group leads, so its label is the one desktop trigger, and its three platform entries carry `icon` (box, globe, smartphone) and `description` (header.chrome_support / browser_support / mobile_support through `t`) so base draws them as the cards the old header's left column had, with AI Chat, Productivity, Tools and Summary as the headed columns beside them. The base_sdk floor is 1.18.0 since 1.9.0: `description` and `icon` are extra properties on a HeaderMenuLink literal, which TypeScript rejects against an older HeaderMenu, so 1.9.0 must not be composed over base_sdk <= 1.17.0. Since 1.10.0 rokct.ai's plans query is registered here too (Ray, 2026-09-09: the hosting shell is a separate frontend on the control site that shows ONLY hosting-related subscriptions, "this means rokctai_frontend will also filter out hosting related subscriptions"): components/custom/landing/agent-plans-query.ts default-exports base's generic LANDING_CONFIG.plansQuery - same doctype, fields and order - with one server-side filter laid over its payload, [["plan_category", "!=", "Hosting"]], and registers it with one line at base_sdk's // @rokct-sdk-plans-query-start marker (components/custom/landing/plans-query.ts, since base_sdk 1.9.0), so the hosting rows are never fetched; pricing.hiddenCategories in agent-landing-config.ts names "hosting" beside "lms" as the client-side belt to that brace. Every shell filters the shared control catalog by plan_category from its home SDK - the hosting shell's home SDK registers the opposite query (Hosting only) - and no plan id or name is ever written down. The `hosting` entry in pricing.categoryStyles stays: an unused surface is flagged, never removed. The base_sdk floor is unchanged at 1.18.0. Since 1.11.0 the same filter drops the paas category too (Ray, 2026-09-09, once the delivery-platform storefront was ruled the seller of the delivery platform and its paas plans: "means paas plans leave rokct too"): the one filter is now [["plan_category", "not in", ["Hosting", "paas"]]], spelled as the backend fixtures spell the categories because the server compares them verbatim, and pricing.hiddenCategories names "paas" beside "lms" and "hosting" (the frontend compares those case-insensitively). rokct.ai lists neither Hosting nor paas plans: Hosting plans belong to the hosting shell, paas plans to the delivery-platform storefront. A product shell shows only its own plan categories, registered in base's plans-query registry by that shell's home SDK, never by editing the backend. The base_sdk floor is unchanged at 1.18.0. Since 1.12.0 rokct.ai's REGISTER is here too (Ray, 2026-09-09: "register is not fitting for all, what rokct need is not what all needs, any home sdk need to inject what it needs, just like dart auth sdk has"): auth_sdk 1.7.0 owns the register FLOW (first name, last name, email, password, the sign-in) and moved everything rokct-specific OUT of its actions.ts and auth-form.tsx - control provisioning under the platform administrator's keys (control:provision_service_subscription / control:provision_new_tenant), the plan select and ?plan= prefill, the industry catalogue (getIndustries), the country and currency lookup (get_pricing_metadata), the voucher, the service-plan domain and the plan-dependent auto-login rule - behind two one-marker single-answer registries. This SDK injects them back: components/custom/auth/agent-register-config.ts (the RegisterConfig - enabled, rokct's copy, the plan / industry / company_name / country / voucher_code / domain fields, no steps) registered with one line at // @rokct-sdk-register-start (components/custom/auth/register-registry.ts), and app/(auth)/agent-register-provision.ts (the RegisterProvisioner - the removed control flow over app/(auth)/agent-register-helpers.ts, with getIndustries() as the server action app/(auth)/agent-register-actions.ts) registered with one line at // @rokct-sdk-register-provision-start (app/(auth)/register-provision.ts). Credentials come from auth's tenant link (adminCredentials) and go out as an Authorization header; no key is written down. The provisioner touches no database: the local user row that maps an email to its site is auth's write, and the provisioner hands the site back as the outcome's siteName. Service-or-tenant is decided on the server from the plan catalogue with the rule the old form used to reveal its domain field (plan_type Service, or a name involving hosting), because a RegisterField has no visibility rule. The chrome glyph is back on the header's Add ROK Extension action: base_sdk 1.20.0 added HeaderMenuAction.icon and the "chrome" glyph (lucide's own mark), so agent-header-menu.ts sets icon: "chrome" on add-extension and nothing else about the menu changes. Floors: base_sdk >= 1.20.0 (HeaderMenuAction.icon) and auth_sdk >= 1.7.0 (the two register registries) since 1.12.0. Since 1.13.0 rokct.ai says where base_sdk 1.23.0's NETWORK STRIP goes (Ray, 2026-09-09: rokct.ai must not list his other products as choices - each has its own shell - but a founder on its free opportunities pages must still learn about them, from a clickable logo strip headed "Trusted by", his wording: "these products already trust rokct as they run on it"; asked whether rokct's existing logos section is enough: it is not - logos.tsx is a marquee of Walmart/Cisco/Netflix/Pinterest/Zoom/Sony/Ebay/Uber images hotlinked from a third party's CDN, none a link, landing only, and it STAYS: an unused surface is flagged, never removed). base holds the ONE list of the network's sites (components/custom/landing/network-sites.ts: rokct.ai, Supacharge, juvo; hosting and telephony hidden until Ray picks their domains) and draws the strip minus the shell it is on; components/custom/landing/agent-network-strip.ts default-exports this shell's NetworkStripConfig - placement { landing: "afterHero", footer: true }, nothing else: base's heading, the list's order, nothing hidden - registered with one line at // @rokct-sdk-network-strip-start (components/custom/landing/network-strip.ts). afterHero puts the strip right under the hero on /landing, the slot a trusted-by row takes and above this SDK's own logos marquee; footer true puts it above base's FooterChromeRow, which is how pages outside /landing - the opportunities pages, once they exist as routes; today the hero's results link to /opportunities/<type>/<slug> and no such route is installed by this SDK or the shell - get it, PROVIDED rokctai_frontend's host footer.tsx renders FooterChromeRow (it keeps its own copyright row today; that adoption is a host edit). The module imports nothing from base and states its shape structurally, like agent-site-metadata.ts, so against base_sdk < 1.23.0 the integration is skipped with a warning and the file compiles unused. The base_sdk floor is 1.23.0 since 1.13.0 (the network-strip registry); a base between 1.20.0 and 1.22.0 still composes, minus the strip. Also since 1.13.0 Telephony plans leave rokct.ai (Ray, 2026-09-09: the product plan categories leave rokct.ai; they sell on the telephony shell): the one filter is [["plan_category", "not in", ["Hosting", "paas", "Telephony"]]] and pricing.hiddenCategories names "telephony" beside "lms", "hosting" and "paas"; the `telephony` entry in pricing.categoryStyles stays - an unused surface is flagged, never removed. Also since 1.13.0 AGENT_LANDING_CONFIG.logos is null (Ray, 2026-09-09: "everything served from another company cdn tells you is placeholder"): the eight marks hotlinked from a chat template's CDN are gone, logos.tsx stays registered and renders nothing on null, and the network strip takes the slot under the hero. Since 1.14.0 the shell needs base_sdk >= 1.24.0: the header-menu registration declares the collapsing, badged brand and the secondary action variant that version added (Ray, 2026-09-09: "header lost functions the old rokct header had"; rokct.ai keeps everything its old host header had). Since 1.15.0 the Chrome Web Store MARK is served by the shell itself (Ray, 2026-09-09, on the icon the old header hot-linked from a third party's CDN and the 1.14.0 restore left out for that reason: "i dont think merlin owns [the icon] so use it but bring it local"): templates/public/brand/marks/chrome-web-store.svg installs to public/brand/marks/ through the same public/brand mapping lms_sdk's marks use; agent-header-menu.ts sets it as the image icon on add-extension (base_sdk 1.25.0's HeaderMenuAction.icon takes `{ src, alt }` beside the named glyphs) in place of lucide's "chrome" glyph, and components/custom/landing/agent-hero-copy.ts - this SDK's first hero copy, registered with one line at // @rokct-sdk-hero-copy-start - lays ONE field over base's HERO_CONFIG: its badges with the Chrome Web Store badge's icon as that same file, every other badge and every word base's own. The base_sdk floor is 1.25.0 since 1.15.0: an object icon on a HeaderMenuAction literal is rejected by an older HeaderMenuAction, so 1.15.0 must not be composed over base_sdk <= 1.24.0. Also since 1.15.0 the hero's Google Play badge, which base 1.23.0 had left without an icon (so undrawn), draws google-play.svg - the coloured Play triangle in Google's brand colours - through the same hero copy (Ray, 2026-09-09: "we use what these platforms use for familiarity"); the App Store badge keeps base's Apple glyph. Since 1.16.0 the marks are base_sdk 1.26.0's, not this SDK's (Ray, 2026-09-09: rokct.ai gets the same official App Store file supacharge has): base installs public/brand/marks/chrome-web-store.svg, google-play.svg, app-gallery.svg, app-store.svg and windows.svg on every host, so templates/public/brand/marks/ and the public/brand mapping are gone from this SDK, which now installs nothing under public/. agent-hero-copy.ts and agent-header-menu.ts keep the same /brand/marks/ path strings - naming that path is how a home SDK opts into base's file - and the hero copy now hands the App Store badge { src: "/brand/marks/app-store.svg", alt: "App Store" } too, in place of base's built-in Apple glyph, so all three of rokct.ai's badges draw the official files. base applies the dark-mode treatment for app-store.svg and windows.svg itself, keyed on the src basename, and never filters a coloured mark, so this SDK ships no CSS for them. The base_sdk floor is 1.26.0 since 1.16.0: against an older base those paths resolve to no file and the badges and the header CTA draw a broken image. Since 1.17.0 the logos section IS rokct.ai's "Trusted by" row (Ray, 2026-09-09: "we now have two trusted by instead of using the logos section rokct had", and "logos should not lose function and its look"): logos.tsx keeps its marquee - the same section, eyebrow, grayscale-to-colour hover, pause on hover, three lanes shifted by a third every 20s through the host's marquee keyframes, the same item box - and its items are base's resolved network sites (loadResolvedNetworkStrip from components/custom/network-strip.tsx: the shell left out by host, base's order, the registered hidden keys) under base's heading, each box a link to the site's origin with target _blank and rel noopener and nothing else - no query string, no click handler. components/custom/landing/agent-logos.ts is the pure track rule (a lane repeats the list to at least eight items, the track is the lane three times, so a two-site list still fills a wide viewport and loops seamlessly). agent-network-strip.ts registers placement { landing: "section", footer: true }: base_sdk 1.27.0's "section" placement leaves base's own afterHero and beforeFooter surfaces empty and, by its once-per-page rule, keeps the footer strip off the landing route - so /landing shows ONE "Trusted by" (the logos section) and every other page (the opportunities pages, careers, legal, status) shows one in the footer, rokctai_frontend's footer.tsx rendering <NetworkStrip surface="footer" /> since host #148. AGENT_LANDING_CONFIG.logos and the LogosConfig type are gone: the list the block held was the eight third-party marks 1.13.0 already turned off, and the section has no copy of its own now. The base_sdk floor is 1.27.0 since 1.17.0: against 1.23.0-1.26.0 the registry's placement type rejects "section" and networkStripRendersAt has no "section" surface. Since 1.18.0 every landing section's ENTRY module is server-safe (Ray's base_sdk 1.32.0, core #215: the landing renders on the server, and app/landing/page.tsx reads each registered module's `meta` through components/custom/landing/landing-page.ts): a module that starts with "use client" hands the server only client-reference proxies, so against 1.32.0 meta.order, meta.nav, meta.renders and meta.rootClass read undefined - the DOM id fell back to the module name, the floating nav said "Scroll to <module>", the header's pricing anchor did not resolve, no renders() rule applied. The rule now: the entry module (the file the page-sections integrations line imports, components/custom/<name>.tsx) carries no "use client", exports `meta` as plain data and a default server component; hooks, state, effects, browser APIs and framer motion live in the sibling components/custom/<name>.client.tsx, which starts with "use client" and is rendered by the entry's default export. floating-nav, chat-section, logos, social-section, workflow-section, pricing, copied-pricing and faq-section are split that way (eight .client.tsx installs); all-features-section and testimonials-section have nothing client-only in them - next/image renders on the server - so the whole section is the entry and there is no sibling. Markup and behaviour are unchanged: the same elements, classes, ids and nav labels, the same client interactions after hydration. `meta.renders` stays pure (no section declares one; none may read window or localStorage). agent-hero-form.tsx and agent-opportunities.tsx keep "use client": base loads the hero form through next/dynamic inside its client hero-view.tsx and the form loads the hero sections itself, so the server never reads a `meta` from them; agent-hero-copy.ts and agent-header-menu.ts never carried the directive. The base_sdk floor is 1.32.0 since 1.18.0: it is the base whose landing-page.ts reads `meta` on the server (a section entry that is a server component renders under 1.28.0-1.31.0's client orchestrator too, but the split is for 1.32.0 and is proven only against it). Since 1.19.0 the network's SITES are declared here (base_sdk 1.40.0; Ray, 2026-09-11: a shell with no declaration shows no strip - a shell outside the network must not list products it has nothing to do with, and site names are brand content base may not hard-code): base carries no site of the network any more, so agent-network-strip.ts sets `sites` - the five entries base's network-sites.ts held from 1.23.0 to 1.39.0, moved entry for entry: rokct.ai, supacharge.school and juvo with the same names, origins and logo paths, and hosting and telephony as the same hidden place-holders (url null, shown false; an unused surface is switched off, never removed) - beside its "section" / footer placement. rokct.ai owns the network, so the list lives with rokct.ai's home SDK; lms_sdk's registration keeps supacharge off the strip and a shell with no registration draws none. Nothing else changes: base still leaves rokct.ai itself out by host, keeps its default heading, the list's order, and draws the logos section on /landing and the footer row elsewhere. The base_sdk floor is 1.40.0 since 1.19.0: `sites` is an extra property on a NetworkStripConfig literal, which an older registry's type rejects, so 1.19.0 must not be composed over base_sdk <= 1.39.0. Also since 1.19.0 /chat is a route: templates/app/(chat)/chat/page.tsx re-exports the root chat page's default export, because the header's Chat with ROK action and AI Chat entry, the chat section and the landing config all link to /chat while the only file under chat/ was [id]/page.tsx, so /chat 404'd on the composed shell; the (chat) directory install carries it. /dashboard (the Product group's Web App entry), /affiliate and /teams still lead nowhere - the host's /portal is its Client Portal (telephony and hosting subscriptions), not the chat web app, so that href is not repointed - and tests/test_manifest.py's TestNavLinks names exactly those three as the known exceptions to every header href resolving.
_comment.components/custom/landing/landing-config: installed by base_sdk >= 1.5.0 (LandingNavItem for floating-nav.tsx, planSignupUrl for pricing.tsx); >= 1.10.0 for LandingNavItem.badge, the optional new/soon flag floating-nav.tsx renders when a section sets it
installed by base_sdk >= 1.5.0 (the registry the integrations target; PageSectionMeta/PageSectionProps for the section templates); base_sdk >= 1.32.0 since 1.18.0: that base's landing-page.ts imports each registered entry ON THE SERVER to read `meta`, which is why every section entry this SDK registers carries no "use client" and renders its .client.tsx sibling instead
_comment.app/actions/base/landing.ts: installed by base_sdk >= 1.5.0 (LandingPlan, the plan row type pricing.tsx reads)
_comment.lib/actions/getPricingMetadata.ts: host shell (currency localisation pricing.tsx asks for through agent-landing-config.ts pricing.localize; set it to null to drop it)
_comment.ai/models.ts: host shell (agent-landing-config.ts reads the paid model id for the {model} token in plan features; the chat surface reads it too)
_comment.components/custom/landing/header-menu.ts: installed by base_sdk >= 1.23.0 (the SDK floor since 1.13.0, for the network-strip registry beside it; the header itself needs 1.20.0) (HeaderMenu, the shape agent-header-menu.ts fills, and the registry its integrations line targets; groups and actions exist from 1.14.0, HeaderMenuLink.description and .icon - which this SDK fills since 1.9.0 - from 1.18.0 with the header that renders the groups as one panel, HeaderMenuAction.icon and the "chrome" glyph - which this SDK sets on add-extension since 1.12.0 - from 1.20.0; an older HeaderMenuAction rejects the extra property, so 1.12.0 must not be composed over base_sdk <= 1.19.0) Since 1.14.0 this SDK also fills HeaderBrand.badge and HeaderBrand.collapse (the BETA strip and the collapsing brand rokct.ai's old header had) and sets the "secondary" HeaderMenuAction.variant on chat-rokct - all three base_sdk 1.24.0's; an older HeaderBrand rejects the extra properties, so 1.14.0 must not be composed over base_sdk <= 1.23.0. Since 1.15.0 this SDK sets an IMAGE icon (`{ src, alt }`, HeaderMenuImage) on add-extension - base_sdk 1.25.0's; an older HeaderMenuAction.icon takes only the named glyphs and rejects the object, so 1.15.0 must not be composed over base_sdk <= 1.24.0. Since 1.16.0 the file behind that image icon is base_sdk 1.26.0's public/brand/marks/chrome-web-store.svg, no longer this SDK's, so 1.16.0 must not be composed over base_sdk <= 1.25.0 (the path resolves to nothing there): base_sdk >= 1.26.0.
_comment.components/custom/header-menu.tsx: installed by base_sdk >= 1.25.0 (the menu partials base's header renders this SDK's registered menu with; 1.18.0 for the one-panel mega menu with icon cards, 1.20.0 for the glyph on an action button, 1.25.0 for the image icon on one - the local Chrome Web Store mark this SDK sets since 1.15.0; base_sdk >= 1.26.0 since 1.16.0 for the file itself, public/brand/marks/chrome-web-store.svg, which base installs and this SDK only names)
_comment.components/custom/menu-label.tsx: installed by base_sdk >= 1.14.0 (MenuLabel, the ONE new/soon pill; floating-nav.tsx renders it beside a badged entry so the nav and the header wear the same label)
installed by base_sdk >= 1.15.0 (the site-metadata registry the agent-site-metadata integration targets). OPTIONAL: against base_sdk 1.14.0 the file is absent, sdk_installer_base.py update_integrations() prints 'Integration target not found' and skips the line, and agent-site-metadata.ts - which imports nothing from base - installs and compiles unused
_comment.components/custom/landing/plans-query.ts: installed by base_sdk >= 1.9.0 (the plans-query registry the agent-plans integration targets). agent-plans-query.ts derives its query from landing-config.ts's LANDING_CONFIG.plansQuery (a requires file since 1.4.0, LandingPlansQuery since base_sdk 1.9.0) and lays the plan_category not in [Hosting, paas] filter over it, so it never restates base's field list
_comment.components/custom/auth/register-registry: installed by auth_sdk >= 1.7.0 (RegisterConfig and RegisterFieldOption, the shape agent-register-config.ts fills, and the register registry the agent-register-config integration targets at // @rokct-sdk-register-start). Against auth_sdk <= 1.6.0 the file is absent, the installer prints 'Integration target not found' and skips the line, and the shell keeps auth 1.6.0's inline register page
_comment.app/(auth)/register-provision.ts: installed by auth_sdk >= 1.7.0 (RegisterProvisioner, RegisterSubmission, RegisterOutcome and RegisterSignIn, the contract agent-register-provision.ts answers, and the provisioning registry the agent-register-provision integration targets at // @rokct-sdk-register-provision-start)
_comment.app/(auth)/tenant-link.ts: installed by auth_sdk >= 1.6.0 (loadTenantLink().adminCredentials(), the platform administrator the provisioner and getIndustries() call the control site as; TenantLinkAdmin, the type agent-register-helpers.ts types those keys by)
_comment.lib/actions/getSubscriptionPlans.ts: installed by auth_sdk (the plan catalogue the register config's plan select lists and the provisioner's service-or-tenant and auto-login rules read; still installed by auth_sdk 1.7.0 though nothing in auth reads it)
installed by base_sdk >= 1.27.0 since 1.17.0 and base_sdk >= 1.40.0 since 1.19.0 (the network-strip registry the agent-network-strip integration targets; 1.23.0 added the registry, 1.27.0 the "section" landing placement this SDK registers and the once-per-page rule that keeps the footer strip off /landing, 1.40.0 the `sites` field this SDK fills - base carries no site of the network from 1.40.0, and an older NetworkStripConfig rejects the extra property, which is the floor). Against base_sdk < 1.23.0 the file is absent, sdk_installer_base.py update_integrations() prints 'Integration target not found' and skips the line
_comment.components/custom/landing/hero-config.ts: installed by base_sdk >= 1.23.0 (HERO_CONFIG, whose badges agent-hero-copy.ts lays its one change over, and HeroBadge with the `{ src, alt }` icon it hands the local Chrome Web Store mark through; 1.23.0 for the chrome badge base draws with its own glyph by default; base_sdk >= 1.26.0 since 1.16.0 for the mark files under public/brand/marks/ - chrome-web-store.svg, google-play.svg, app-store.svg - that agent-hero-copy.ts names and base installs); base_sdk >= 1.32.0 since 1.18.0, the base whose hero.tsx is a server component that awaits the registered copy through landing-page.ts resolveHeroConfig() - agent-hero-copy.ts never carried "use client", so its fields are plain data there
_comment.components/custom/landing/hero-copy.ts: installed by base_sdk >= 1.23.0 (the hero-copy registry the agent-hero integration targets, and HeroCopy, the shape agent-hero-copy.ts fills; the registry exists from base_sdk 1.7.0 and is multi-contributor, so this line sits beside any other SDK's; base_sdk >= 1.26.0 since 1.16.0, the base that ships the mark files the registered copy names)
_comment.components/custom/network-strip.tsx: installed by base_sdk >= 1.23.0; loadResolvedNetworkStrip - the registered config and the shell's own host resolved into the sites to draw and the heading - which logos.tsx reads since 1.17.0 to fill its marquee. The "section" surface it then asks networkStripRendersAt for is base_sdk 1.27.0's.
